ns2:section.sectionText: Online scheduled class sessions require each student to have high speed internet access and either a headset with microphone or an external microphone and speakers so they may participate in the class discussions. Wireless internet is not recommended.Center for Innovation in Teaching & Learning (CITL) restrictions and assessments apply, see https://online.illinois.edu. This section is restricted to 1st-time Grad and all non-degree students. As per Board of Trustees approval, the $-205 Tuition reduction only applies to students in the MS: Nat Res Env Sci Online Program (10KS0190MSU) admitted before Fall 2016.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to MS:Crop Sciences -UIUC, MS:Crop Sciences -UIUC, MS: Agricultural Educatn -UIUC, MS:Nat Res Env Sci -UIUC, MS:Nat Res & Envrn Sci -UIUC, NDEG:Grad Nondegree-CE-UIUC, or NDEG:Undergrad Nondeg-CE-UIUC.
